review.tagline: Chinese-language tutorials for deploying and fine-tuning open LLMs on Linux
review.summary: A Datawhale tutorial collection, written mostly in Chinese, that walks through environment setup, local deployment and fine-tuning for 50+ open LLMs such as Qwen, GLM, InternLM, Llama and DeepSeek. Content is Jupyter notebooks and Markdown covering CLI calls, online demos, LangChain integration, LoRA, P-Tuning and distributed full fine-tuning. It also has sections for AMD ROCm, Ascend NPU and Apple M hardware.
review.audience: Chinese-reading students learning to self-host and fine-tune open LLMs
strengths: Covers 50+ open models, each with its own deployment and fine-tuning tutorial
Hardware tracks for AMD ROCm, Ascend NPU and Apple M, beyond NVIDIA
Worked examples such as LoRA fine-tuning on Zhen Huan dialogue and an advanced-math model
Active community project with many named contributors and Apache-2.0 license
weaknesses: Main README and tutorials are in Chinese; English README is a separate file
Linux-centered; the MetaX section is marked Coming Soon
Tutorials are tied to specific model versions and may age as models change
No installable package or app; notebooks only, with no stated hardware requirements
needs: Models: Qwen, GLM, InternLM, Llama, DeepSeek
